subject: general
question: Which of the following is a type of vegetation found in the Himalayan region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alpine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alpine **is a type of vegetation found in the **Himalayan region**.
 
• **Alpine**:
 
 
• This type of vegetation is characterized by **low-growing plants**, **grasses**, mosses, and **lichens adapted to harsh cold and windy conditions** at high altitudes.
 
• The **Himalayas**, being a vast mountain range, have **extensive alpine zones** with diverse flora perfectly suited to this environment.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mangrove**: These are **salt-tolerant trees and shrubs** found in** coastal areas** and **tidal wetlands**, mainly in tropical and **subtropical regions**. The Himalayas are far from the coast and lack the necessary conditions for mangroves to thrive.
 
• **Pampas**: These are** tall grasses **native to **South America**, primarily **Argentina **and **Uruguay**.
 
• **Savannah**: These are **grasslands** with scattered trees and shrubs, typically found in **Africa**.
